title: Force and Laws of Motion
subtitle: Understanding the causes of motion
subject: Science
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Understand the concept of balanced and unbalanced forces
Explain Newton's First Law of Motion and inertia
Calculate momentum and apply Newton's Second Law of Motion
Understand action and reaction in Newton's Third Law of Motion
Apply the law of conservation of momentum in various scenarios

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the fundamental concepts of force and Newton's three laws of motion.
common_misconceptions: Force is needed to keep an object moving at a constant speed.
A larger mass always exerts a larger force.
Action and reaction forces cancel each other out.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Focus on real-world examples like pushing a heavy box, riding a bicycle, or firing a gun to explain the laws.
